info.name: CollabSpace Enterprise API
info.description:
Complete API Collection for CollabSpace Workspace & Project Management Platform.

Built with Laravel 12, JWT Authentication, PostgreSQL/SQLite, WebSockets/Broadcasting, and Google Gemini AI Integrations.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Security
item.description: User registration, login, JWT lifecycle, password recovery, and Google OAuth 2.0 social authentication.

body.raw:
{
    "full_name": "Alex Morgan",
    "email": "alex.morgan@collabspace.io",
    "password": "SecurePass123!",
    "password_confirmation": "SecurePass123!",
    "system_role": "TeamMember",
    "job_title": "Senior Frontend Engineer",
    "years_of_experience": 5
}

request.description: Create a new user account with initial role and profile attributes. Automatically captures and sets the JWT token.
Authenticate using email and password to receive a JWT bearer token.
Fetch details of currently authenticated user including role, permissions, and profile.
Refresh expired or existing JWT access token before expiration.
Invalidate the current JWT bearer token on the server.
Dispatches asynchronous reset password email job containing signed reset token.
Reset account password using the token sent via email.
Returns OAuth 2.0 authorization URL for frontend redirect to Google sign-in.
Handles OAuth 2.0 authorization code redirect from Google.

item.name: Google Auth - Login with ID Token (Mobile/SPA)

request.description: Exchange a client-side Google OAuth ID Token for a CollabSpace JWT authentication session.

item.name: 02. Dashboard & Analytics
item.description: Executive KPI aggregation, chart trends, active project widgets, workload distribution, and recent activity.

request.description: Returns consolidated dashboard payload containing KPIs, analytical charts, active projects, team progress, and files.
Retrieves total projects, total tasks breakdown (pending, in_progress, in_review, completed), and team member counts.
Returns timeseries datasets (labels, completed tasks, created tasks) formatted for Chart.js / ApexCharts.
Returns active projects with progress percentages, deadlines, and assigned team chips.
Returns completion rates and workload metrics grouped per functional department/team.
Returns recently uploaded attachments across accessible projects with uploader details.
Returns upcoming calendar meetings where the authenticated user is organizer or invited participant.

item.name: 03. Teams Management
item.description: CRUD operations for organization teams and roster membership management.

request.description: Retrieve all teams with member counts, active project counts, and completion rates.
Create a functional team (Admin/Manager role required) and assign initial members.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific team, including roster members and assigned projects.
Update team attributes and specifications.
Delete a team and detach its members and project assignments.
Attach a user to the specified team roster.
Remove a user from the specified team roster.

item.description: Project lifecycle management, milestones, and cross-functional team allocation.

request.description: List all projects accessible to the user, with real-time calculated completion rates.

request.description: Create a project and immediately allocate one or more teams to it.
Retrieve full project dossier including assigned teams, tasks summary, and project assets.
Update project details, schedule, or operational status.
Safely delete project along with cascade cleanup of associated records.
Allocate an existing team to the project workspace.
Deallocate a team from the project workspace.

item.name: Update Task Status (Drag & Drop Column Move)

request.description: Transition task status between Kanban columns (pending, in_progress, in_review, completed). Automatically syncs progress to 100% when completed.
Delete a task and its comments and attachments.

item.name: 06. Task Comments & Nested Threads
item.description: Nested discussion threads on specific tasks supporting hierarchical parent-child replies.

request.description: Retrieve root-level comments for a task along with their recursive child replies.
Post a new top-level comment on the task.
Post a reply targeting an existing comment via parent_id.
Delete comment (author or admin only). Child replies cascade automatically.

item.name: 07. Real-Time Chat & Direct Messaging
item.description: Project channels, team chats, 1-on-1 direct messaging (Inbox), unread counts, and WebSocket event triggers.

request.description: Returns active projects and team channels for populating the chat navigation sidebar.
Lists public and team-scoped communication channels available within the project.
Fetch paginated messages for a channel with sender avatars, attachments, @mentions, and replies.
Send message to project channel. Triggers real-time broadcasting event on private-project.{projectId}.{channelName}.
Records read receipts for all messages in the specified project channel.
Fetch user inbox threads showing the other participant, unread count, and snippet of latest message.
Start or retrieve a 1-on-1 thread with another user and optionally send an opening message.
Retrieve paginated direct messages for a thread and automatically marks incoming messages as read.
Send a 1-on-1 message in an active thread. Broadcasts on private-inbox.{threadId}.
Mark all incoming unread messages in the thread as read.
